''See also: [[Path of the Stellar Spear Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Path]] of the [[Stellar Spear]] is a sacred art characterized by light-aspected combat techniques and the use of spear-based weaponry. It is the signature [[Path]] of the [[Jai clan]], a family that once unified the [[Desolate Wilds]] through violent rule. The [[Path]] utilizes [[madra]] that is a combination of light and [[sword]] [[aspects]], often manifesting as silver-white or starlight-colored energy. Practitioners of this [[Path]] exhibit a distinct [[Goldsign]] in the form of metallic hair that reflects light. Notable techniques associated with this [[Path]] include the [[Star Lance]], a [[Striker technique]] used by clan members and bodyguards, and the [[Star's Edge|Star’s Edge]], an [[Enforcer technique]] that reinforces a weapon rather than the user's body. Advanced practitioners may utilize more complex arts, such as the Fall of Seven Stars. While the original version of the [[Path]] is considered highly potent, a branch known as the [[Path]] of the [[Broken Star]] exists, and some members of the [[Jai clan]] have practiced a warped or twisted version of the original arts. The [[Path]] is also linked to the [[Ancestor's Spear]], a powerful weapon created by ancient [[Soulsmiths]] that features specialized [[scripts]] and the ability to absorb [[madra]].}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The [[Path]] of the [[Stellar Spear]] is a specialized path utilized by members of the [[Jai clan]]. This path, which is available to artists, is characterized by the use of specific [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]]. One such [[Goldsign]] associated with this path consists of frozen hair.}}
